creative_brief.emotional_promise: Opening the booklet should feel like entering a tiny observatory, then make the first constellation bloom possible in under a minute.
creative_brief.format_rationale: Four A5 pages give the 84 by 76 mm object room for true product views, legible assembly actions, the decisive dial motion, three endpoint readings, and complete care and safety without crowding.
creative_brief.physical_format: Four-page A5 portrait owner booklet, designed for folded-sheet printing.
teaching_arc: Meet the Moonwake Garden and perform the decisive first move.
Identify the three printed parts and their exact layer order.
Assemble on the spindle and press only above the four corners.
Hold toward a brighter ambient background and roll the exposed right-edge rim.
Read Cassiopeia, Cygnus, and the Little Dipper within Ursa Minor.
Reset, troubleshoot, pack away, care for the object, and use it safely.
typography: Labels — embedded DejaVu Sans Bold uppercase
creative_brief.visual_motif: Exact dark petal silhouettes become observatory windows, while gold action cues trace the real right-edge grip and the three physical layers.

findings: Page 4 safety text overflowed its rounded panel in both color and grayscale and collided with the closing description.
The first-render right-edge motion tag needed a stronger grayscale-safe cue that pointed directly to the real rim.
The cover caption crossed mixed black and white image areas, weakening contrast.
The exploded product view needed explicit layer-order labeling for grayscale readers.
resolved_changes: Reduced and reflowed the safety copy inside a taller panel, then confirmed clear separation from the closing description in both final render sets.
Changed the dial cue to a dark high-contrast ROLL THIS RIM tag and added a leader line to the exact exposed grip.
Moved the Cassiopeia caption onto the clean midnight field beneath the product view.
Added a high-contrast 1 REAR · 2 DIAL · 3 FACE strip to the exact exploded view.
